parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is a switch handle of the faucet made of stainless steel, typically cylindrical with a lever for turning water flow on or off.
parts.Functional_description: It controls the water flow and temperature by rotating or lifting the handle.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or tilts to adjust water flow and temperature.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is a base frame of the faucet made of stainless steel, providing structural support for the switch handle.
parts.Functional_description: It anchors the switch handle to the sink surface and connects to internal plumbing.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is another base frame of the faucet made of stainless steel, supporting the opposite switch handle.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a stable mount for the second switch and connects to the water supply lines.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during use.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the central frame base of the faucet made of stainless steel, supporting the spout structure.
parts.Functional_description: It connects the spout to the sink and internal water lines, ensuring stability.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: This is the spout of the faucet made of stainless steel, shaped in an arched form for water delivery.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the water flow from the faucet to the sink basin.
parts.Movement_description: It may swivel horizontally to direct water flow to different sink areas.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is another switch handle of the faucet made of stainless steel, similar to the first one.
parts.Functional_description: It controls either hot or cold water flow depending on the plumbing configuration.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or tilts to adjust water flow and temperature.
